name: fathom-rebuild
description: 8x take-home: a rebuild of fathom.video - the AI meeting notetaker

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute fathom-db --local --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute fathom-db --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute fathom-db --remote --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute fathom-db --remote --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.test: python3 tools/capture/test_capture.py && node --test tests/ && node scripts/extension-check.mjs
scripts.preflight: python3 tools/capture/capture.py validate && python3 tools/capture/test_capture.py && node --test tests/ && npx tsc --noEmit && python3 scripts/smoke-test.py && node scripts/browser-check.mjs && node scripts/extension-check.mjs && python3 tools/capture/capture.py validate --strict || echo 'NOTE: strict validation fails while a turn is open - capture the response first'
